newsitem.title: USA: Urethane to acquire PMC Inc unit.
newsitem.headline: Urethane to acquire PMC Inc unit.

text.p: Urethane Technologies Inc said on Tuesday it has signed a letter of intent to merge with PMC Inc unit IPI into a new publicly held company.
The deal, subject to customary approvals, will result in a combined company about twice the size of UTI, the company said in a statement.

PMC shareholders will receive a 45 percent ownership of the combined company, while UTI will hold the remaining 55 percent. The deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997. Other details were not immediately available.
IPI is a supplier of two-component polyurethane systems with 1995 sales of about $37 million.
Urethane Technologies also said following a review it has revalued its inventory downward by approximately $356,000.
Urethane Technologies said later it has about 10.6 million shares outstanding and that it plans to issue about an additional nine million shares to pay for the acquisition.
